verdict.rationale: Bento gives agents programmatic access through a hosted MCP server, a CLI and an API. Audiences are covered by subscriber search with tag, segment and date filters, and the broadcasts API supports reviewing broadcast history. However, nothing shows an agent can list live workflows or sequences, or pull per-campaign performance results. missing for 10: documented read access to live automations (workflows/sequences) and their status, campaign performance metrics (opens/clicks/revenue) via API/MCP, hands-on corroboration of agent-driven reporting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working

citations.quote: Bento hosts the MCP server at `https://mcp.bentonow.com/mcp`. You point your AI app at that URL and add your API keys.
The Bento MCP server gives your AI assistant direct access to your Bento account. It can look up subscribers, create broadcasts, track events, and more

Filter by tags, a segment, or by date ranges on creation, update, last event, and unsubscribe times.
Use the API to review broadcast history, create campaigns, and schedule approved sends with explicit audience rules.
The Bento CLI gives you 50+ commands for managing your entire Bento account.
